title: Data analyst
_note: Technical round built from the Data analyst tasks in content/reference/occupations.json, which the team wrote from the eMASCO title (emasco.mohr.gov.my/masco/2524-03) and has not yet checked against the eMASCO task list. Behavioural round: behavioural.json. Rubric format: content/interview/sets.ts.

questions.text: You get a spreadsheet of sales data from three branches. How would you check it for errors before you analyse it?
questions.why: wrong data gives confident but wrong answers.
questions.source: 2524-03 task 1 (content/reference/occupations.json): Gather data from databases and spreadsheets and check it for errors. Task written by the team from the eMASCO title; not yet checked against the eMASCO task list.

keyPoints.point: look for missing or blank values
check formats and units are consistent
check for outliers or impossible values

questions.text: A manager asks why sales dropped last month. Walk us through how you would answer with data.
questions.why: analysts turn a vague question into a clear answer.
questions.source: 2524-03 task 2 (content/reference/occupations.json): Analyse data to answer questions from managers and teams. Task written by the team from the eMASCO title; not yet checked against the eMASCO task list.

keyPoints.point: break the data down to find the cause

questions.text: Tell us about a chart or dashboard you made. How did you choose what to show and how to show it?
questions.why: a finding only helps if people understand it quickly.
questions.source: 2524-03 task 3 (content/reference/occupations.json): Present findings in reports, charts and dashboards. Task written by the team from the eMASCO title; not yet checked against the eMASCO task list.

keyPoints.point: start from the audience and their question
